contract.layout: scalar paths plus flattened offset/count interactions
contract.derivatives: optional tangent or adjoint continuous payload with primal-identical fixed-winner indexing

backend_audit.drjit_reflection: global primitive IDs, interaction positions, normals, and segment lengths available
backend_audit.torch_reflection: global primitive IDs and segment lengths public; positions and normals remain internal tape
backend_audit.drjit_diffraction: tx/rx/order, global edges, positions, delay, and complex field available
backend_audit.torch_diffraction: tx/rx/order, global edges, positions, delay, and split real/imag field available

native_build: not required; header-only POD contract and pure-Python adapters
